title: A Neural JKO Scheme for Hellinger-Kantorovich Gradient Flows via Monge-Growth Pairs
summary: We develop a mesh-free neural JKO scheme for advection-reaction-diffusion equations with a gradient-flow structure in the Hellinger-Kantorovich (HK) geometry of unbalanced optimal transport. Each update is parametrized by a spatial map and a mass-changing factor, allowing spatial redistribution and local mass creation or loss to be treated jointly within a single variational step. Their cone action bounds the squared HK distance from above, yielding a sufficient condition for discrete energy dissipation through comparison with the identity pair.
